Two suspects have been arrested in connection with the murder of Christina Downer , “ Saturday Night Live ” writer Jimmy Fowlie ’s sister, according to the Los Angeles Police Department .
Delorean Bijon Brandon, 41, Downer’s boyfriend, and Kaylee Nicole Markowski, 34, were arrested Thursday in Highland Park and Tarzana, respectively. Detectives believe Brandon and Markowski were responsible for Downer’s murder and then disposed of her body and concealed the crime. Downer was reported missing after a welfare check on Dec. 18, 2025, and Brandon claimed she had moved out and left behind her car and dog.
LAPD said law enforcement officials continued to investigate Downer’s disappearance after her cell phone washed ashore on the beach in Santa Monica. Authorities were led to search an Airbnb property in Joshua Tree, located in the high desert several hours from Los Angeles, in connection with her disappearance and conducted an extensive search with K-9 units and the San Bernardino County Sheriff’s Department.
Downer is “no longer alive,” her brother said on April 29.
“Our prayers for her to be found safely have transformed into prayers for the truth to be revealed and for those responsible to be held accountable,” Fowlie’s post from April 29 read. “We have reason to believe that in the weeks before she went missing, her phone and social media were compromised. The individual(s) in possession of her phone used it to hide the fact she was gone, to ask for money and to create a false narrative that she was going ‘off the grid.’”
